title: Centrifuge CP172 Passes, Plans 1:1 CFG-to-Equity Conversion: Guest Post by Coincu
ai_summary: Centrifuge's CP172 proposal passed with 98.53% voting weight, authorizing a planned 1:1 conversion of CFG tokens into shares in Centrifuge, Inc. The conversion remains conditional on board approval, a Cayman restructuring, and legal structuring, with no launch date set. Holders below 100,000 CFG would use a CoinList trust.
